title: Auto-growing HNSW capacity
change_summary: max_elements is initial HNSW capacity; the index doubles via resizeIndex under the DB mutex, with optional max_capacity. Python GIL release, Node Float32Array and async search, skip_empty_ts on ts-range search.
bindings_note: Python, Node, and C++. On-disk format unchanged. logosdb-mcp-server stays 1.4.6.
tagline: Embedded vector DB for AI agents and RAG
release_tagline: The index doubles when it fills. Search can leave the caller thread.

highlights.name: auto-grow
highlights.desc: This vector DB doubles HNSW capacity when an insert would pass the starting size.

highlights.name: hard cap
highlights.desc: Set max_capacity when this vector DB should stop at a fixed number of slots.

highlights.name: async search
highlights.desc: Node can search this vector DB with a Promise. Python search releases the GIL.

install: pip install logosdb   ·   npm i logosdb
